description: Audit a site and compare it to a report saved earlier with the goflag CLI (--report or --update-baseline). Returns what is new, what was resolved, and how many findings are unchanged: the question a change has to answer is whether it made things worse.

advisories.description: Also return the questions a linter cannot settle, with their evidence, for you to judge.

baseline.description: Path to the saved JSON report, relative to where this server runs.

checkExternal.description: Also probe links to other sites. Off by default: slow, and not your site's fault.

expectIndexing.description: "no" for a staging or preview host that must stay out of search indexes.

locales.description: Locales the site serves, e.g. ["en", "fr"], when its sitemap does not say.

static.description: Never launch Chromium; judge the server-rendered HTML only.

url.description: The site to audit, http or https. A dev server's URL works: http://localhost:3000.

name: compare_to_baseline
title: Compare to a baseline
